_capture.provenance: synthetic — declared, never presented as a recording (GOR-245 specs.md § 6.14(2)). **§ 4.4 forbids executing `POST /applications/{id}/pay` against any host**, absolutely, and forbids the tempting workaround of creating a case so that there is something to pay for — named as the one thing most forbidden and audited as security-review item 6. specs.md § 8.5 gap G-2 records the consequence: NO pay response has ever been observed from any host, so this body is shaped from the declared type and the component that reads it, not from traffic. Every Tier 3 verdict for the surfaces it drives is NOT EVALUATED with that reason.
_capture.credential: none — no citizen token was obtained or seeded, and no POST was issued to any host (§ 4.4; security-review.md item 6)
_capture.field_discipline: The union of `types.ts:573-582` and `PaymentSection.tsx:43-57` (specs.md § 5.3). The two documented shapes disagree and the source reads BOTH — the component says so in its own comment — so the fixtures cover both arms rather than picking one. No field appears that neither source declares.
_capture.synthetic_values: Receipt numbers use the reserved `RCPT-9000xx` block and account numbers the all-zero `000-00-00-00000` shape. No real receipt number, account number, UIN or name appears (§ 7.9 items 4 and 5).
_capture.exercises: `B6-DIV-3` at its most exposed (§ 6.9(5), § 6.10, security-review item 4). An instruction carrying a `qr_payload` and NOTHING else identifying — no account, no reference. The panel prints the payload verbatim beneath a QR bitmap that DOES NOT ENCODE IT, and the reference row falls all three steps to the mounting page's `reference`. Kept as a separate fixture from the bank one precisely so a test cannot satisfy both branches with one body.
